source.note: Instrument models, component pairings and calibration/check requirements are controlled facts. The directive names FH40 G-L10 + FHZ 512A, Electra + detector and RadEye SX + detector as systems whose component pairing is currently missing (§4.5), but the authoritative register lives in the 1.0.0.8 baseline package, which was not supplied. Directive §49 forbids inventing instrument models.
